name: shadow_box
text: A person shadowboxes in place in a staggered stance, keeping both hands up beside the cheeks. Throw a left straight punch forward and retract to guard, then a right straight punch and retract. Repeat the alternating straight punches with torso rotation and small weight shifts, no target and no kicking.

review.notes_zh: 稳定防护站姿，左右交替直臂出击并收回，各两次；用明确的腕部前伸目标修正首版只出单侧拳的问题。首尾同姿态可循环，固定放松手指，手形不是握拳。
